The '''Radell Mining Corporate Headquarters''' building was a pyramidal structure on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]], in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Elrooden]], housing the corporate headquarters of the [[Radell Mining Corporation]].
